name: marqeta
description: Look up cardholders, cards, card products, transactions, disputes, and spend controls.

MARQETA_API_URL.title: Marqeta API URL
MARQETA_API_URL.description: Base URL for the Marqeta Core API, for example sandbox-api.marqeta.com.

MARQETA_USERNAME.title: Marqeta application token
MARQETA_USERNAME.description: Application token from app.marqeta.com/development. Sent as the HTTP Basic username.

MARQETA_PASSWORD.title: Marqeta admin access token
MARQETA_PASSWORD.description: Admin access token from app.marqeta.com/development. Sent as the HTTP Basic password.
